coordinate_system: approved idle fixed512 HD; new HIP original raw fullsheet top-left slot
training_definition: Manually read center of the broad main silver face of each screen-side hip plate. Exclude gold rim, leather mounting, straps and detached highlight pixels. Select same named silver face before fitting; not bbox/foot points.
heldout_definition: Topmost and bottommost main silver-body boundary point, excluding gold mounting rim; manually read separately, never used by solver.

uncertainty.kind: manual image reading bounds, not statistical confidence

additional_heldout_not_fitted: entire plate contour except center observations
outer waist contour and upper edge
all four legs width and length
caveat: Same costume structures are visible but plate shapes and screen-facing tilt differ. Only a new design reference study, not original anatomical scale truth. Centers alone supply weak fit evidence. No alternate points if heldout fails.
